description: This file is a shell testing script for Git, specifically testing how Git's pack and integrity verification handle missing commit objects and corruption scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution; used here to set up various failure scenarios in Git.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail; verifies that error conditions are correctly triggered.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
